## Intended outcome

State the user-authorized engineering result and task packet. Geographic investigation has no public packet; publish only permitted conclusions. Never paste investigation history, source ledgers, queries, proof chains or identifying context.

## Scope and identity

- Exact base / tested head:
- Primary layer / touched layers (UI, visual engine, map geography, memory attachment):
- Authoritative inputs / permitted outputs; cross-layer dependencies and unchanged boundaries:
- Affected places, periods, scenes, batches or contract owners:
- Exclusions and any approved scope changes:
- Existing task scope recorded before construction, including sandbox work; deliverable/evidence destinations:

## Documentation alignment (required on every PR push/update)

- [ ] Read the affected canonical docs before implementation and recorded/reused the repository task scope.
- [ ] Declared layer scope using ARCHITECTURE; kept session, spatial/time and content ownership at their existing boundaries.
- [ ] Compared the full PR diff against the latest base and reviewed documentation **before tests/build/CI**.
- [ ] Updated relevant docs **in this PR**, or explicitly justified why existing documentation is still accurate.
- [ ] Checked the full diff and metadata for prohibited geographic investigation records, including deleted-content descriptions and CI output.
- [ ] Checked local links, stale status/handoff wording, and the distinction between proposed, tested, merged and deployed.
- Docs updated (paths), **or** "none — reason":
- Remaining documentation uncertainty (if any; not an automatically activated task):
- Validation after documentation review (local results and actual-head GitHub CI; identify pending event-triggered checks):

## Evidence

| Acceptance ID | Actual observation | Tested revision / consumer | Remaining gap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

Separate document checks, runtime/visual evidence and user approval. A build is not a walkthrough; reconstructed art is not historical proof.
For each touched layer, name the actual consumer and applicable acceptance from VERIFICATION. A documentation-only change reports source/contract/link checks and actual-head CI applicability; it does not inherit a previous runtime pass or require unrelated new screenshots.

## Delivery and recovery

- Content/art/publication approval state:
- Main changed or merge pending:
- Publication/deployment performed or explicitly not performed:
- Recovery/rollback:
- Task routing closed and next action preserved:
